summary.text: Newt McCutcheon is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 49, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Byron Tucker Jr. for a seat with no incumbent.
He won the May 12, 2026 Republican primary over incumbent Stanley Adkins, 795 votes to 529.
